claim: Corrected paper-described Adam experiment (variant C); multiclass 27-class; paper-described settings with documented assumptions; not an exact reproduction of Table 4.
base_commit_note: Written on top of HEAD da89a2ce70c6ddbbe31b8421da8ff7866e51a277 with an uncommitted working tree (repair files uncommitted).
supersedes_nothing: Historical AdamW config configs/milestone1_paper_described.json (variant B) is unchanged and remains a separately labelled historical variant.

split.note: Shared saved split reused from variant B. The test partition was previously exposed to the old smoke check (see docs/MILESTONE1_SMOKE_EXPOSURE.md) and previously evaluated in A/B; it is NOT a fresh untouched test set. A confirmatory study would be separate.

preprocessing.clamping: none; finite held-out values outside [0,1] are kept

sequence.construction: repeat scaled row 50 times; training-only Gaussian noise std 0.01; evaluation noise-free

training.optimizer_defaults_note: foreach, fused, capturable, differentiable left at torch defaults (not passed); effective optimizer.defaults are recorded in training_complete.json. If the installed torch exposes a decoupled_weight_decay argument it is passed False; torch 2.5.1 has none.
training.optimizer_type_evidence: Paper Section 5.1 (PDF p.13) names 'Adam' with learning rate 1e-3 and weight decay 1e-4. The paper does not state whether the decay is L2-in-gradient or decoupled. torch.optim.Adam(weight_decay=...) is the direct reading. AdamW is a different procedure and is NOT claimed equivalent or more correct.
training.checkpoint_rule: final epoch 25; no validation or test based selection
training.rng_policy: global seed once before model construction; shuffle and noise from local generators derived from sha256(seed, epoch, batch)

domain_policy.epsilon_budget: L-infinity around the original normalized input
domain_policy.feasible_set_eps_gt_0: lower=maximum(x-eps,0), upper=minimum(x+eps,1); initialization and every update projected onto it
domain_policy.infeasible: lower>upper raises InfeasibleConstraintError (exit 6); no epsilon enlargement, no input modification, no dropped examples
domain_policy.eps_zero: exact unchanged copy; no perturbation or domain correction performed
domain_policy.clean_evaluation: finite values outside [0,1] accepted; never clamped

pgd.step_size_primary_choice: Section 5.4 (experiment-specific: eps 0.10, 7 steps, alpha 0.025 = eps/4, random start) chosen before any run over Section 3.3 generic formula alpha=eps/K=0.10/7=0.0142857, which is documented, conflicts, and is NOT run.

attack.random_start_seed_policy: local torch.Generator seeded from sha256('pgd-random-start|<training_seed>|<batch_index>'); global RNG untouched
attack.protocol_validity: perturbations are not guaranteed to be valid network traffic or preserve flow semantics

evaluation.population: full saved test partition, 4500 rows per seed

smoke_policy.train_ids: first 10 per class (ascending) from saved TRAIN partition only
smoke_policy.validation_ids: first 5 per class (ascending) from saved VALIDATION partition only

metrics.macro_f1: unweighted mean of 27 per-class F1 values, zero_division=0
metrics.per_class: precision, recall, F1, support for all 27 labels
metrics.std: sample standard deviation ddof=1 over completed seeds; n<2 -> unavailable
metrics.paper_f1_note: Table 4 F1 averaging not established; we report both macro and weighted; neither is asserted to match Table 4
metrics.paper_asr_note: Table 4 ASR denominator not established; our ASR uses clean-correct denominator

paper_table4_correspondence: unresolved; Table 4 is context only. Lower or higher accuracy does not prove Table 4 used a different classification task.
